title: Quietly Quenched French Pasta Bowl
description: A citrusy and aerated French dish designed to cure hangovers, featuring a plant-based friendly pasta water emulsion and a touch of mustard powder, served in an earthenware bowl.
instructions: Bring the water to a boil in a large pot and cook the pappardelle pasta according to the package instructions until al dente.
Reserve 1 cup of pasta water before draining the pappardelle and set it aside.
In a blender or food processor, combine the reserved pasta water, lemon juice, olive oil, mustard powder, garlic powder, and salt, and blend until smooth and emulsified.
In a large earthenware bowl, combine the cooked pappardelle pasta, the emulsified sauce, and chopped fresh parsley, and toss to coat.
Season with additional salt to taste if needed.
Serve the Quietly Quenched French Pasta Bowl immediately, garnished with extra parsley if desired.
